messages.subject: Tree graph
parts:
Dear Mr. Williams,

 

Using Rattle a lot more recently, I am wondering if there is way to present nicer Tree graph.  Would you please help? If a tree is so complicated, there is almost no way to make the graph looks pretty.  So I try to build not so complicated a tree, but it still does not look satisfactory.

 

Please advise.

 

Thanks,

 

Albert
